parameters.content:
## LLM rate limit check

### How it works
1. A workflow whose LLM call failed calls this with the error, the model, how many times it has called before (`attempt`) and the item it sent.
2. On a rate limit (429) it asks the provider once more with a one-token request. While the limit holds the provider refuses it without spending tokens, and the refusal says which limit it is and when it clears.
3. A per-minute limit waits the time the provider names and returns `rate_limit.action: retry` with the item, so the caller sends it again.
4. A per-day limit returns `action: stop` with the model, the limit and `resets_at`. The caller stops instead of failing.
5. Anything else returns `action: other` with the message: not a rate limit, or still limited after 6 waits.

Give the caller's LLM node an error output and route this workflow's answer with a Switch on `rate_limit.action`.

### Setup steps
- [ ] Connect the LLM provider credential to **Ask Provider Again** (it calls the chat and models endpoints)
- [ ] Publish: callers run the published version
- [ ] In each caller, an **Execute Workflow** node passing `error`, `model`, `attempt` (`$runIndex`) and `item` (`$json`)

nodes.name: Ask Provider Again
nodes.notes: The LLM node keeps only "too many requests" and drops the 429 body. On a rate limit this asks the same model once more with a one-token request: while the limit holds it is refused (costs nothing) and the refusal names the limit. Any other error sends a GET the provider rejects unread (free); its answer is not used.

parameters.jsonBody: ={{ JSON.stringify({ model: $json.model, messages: [{ role: 'user', content: 'ok' }], max_tokens: 1 }) }}

nodes.name: Wait Out Rate Limit
nodes.notes: Waits the delay a retry needs (0 s for stop and other), so every answer leaves through this node, the one whose item goes back to the caller. Under 65 s, so n8n keeps the run in memory.

parameters.content:
## Ask the provider which limit
One more one-token request reads the 429 body the LLM node drops. The answer is retry, stop or other.
